limits: The paired eastern escalators and courtyard arrival are documented by the official schematic and dated 2014 photograph; exact lane positions, incline and dimensions remain provisional.
The upper endpoint follows the current source-anchored central corridor. A 30 degree incline and retained 1m lanes are explicit construction assumptions.

The municipal source has a broad courtyard envelope near Y29.973m. It does not resolve the photographed garden and arrival level changes, furniture or exact lower landing. Those must be refined before station integration.

The current game uses an inferred Y33.5m arrival floor at a different northing. The new bank is an isolated construction candidate; do not join it to that retained floor or silently move the court furniture.
The short arrival apron is part of this component only; it does not substitute for the complete public courtyard and onward route.
Stationary casing and handrail geometry is derived from the working current-game bank, with its motion settings and lane widths retained. No survey precision is claimed.
The upper landing now uses the provisional western tenth-floor finish propagated through central corridor04; the lower source courtyard plane stays fixed.
